message.content: {"action":"done","summary":"Implemented tinydb/journal.py with BatchWriter(db).apply(operations) for the default table: R01 - validates list of {'op':'insert','document':mapping} / {'op':'remove','doc_id':positive int} ops, returns inserted IDs (removes add none), empty input returns [], unknown/malformed ops (missing keys, non-mapping document, non-positive/non-int/bool doc_id, non-iterable batch) raise ValueError.
